description: [Forge, Fabric, NeoForge] Minecraft mod that adds various blocks and items that prevent/controls Wandering Trader spawns.

mods.name: NoMoWanderer
mods.description: Adds a block and an item that prevents configurable entity spawns. Default entities are the Wandering Trader and the Plague Doctor from the Rats mod.
